text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its current outlook and risk, not by its average cost or the discomfort of realizing a loss.","Selling and then buying back stocks without a clear change in the investment case can turn trading into costly churn; I should define my reasons and rules before each trade.","My account has declined despite several trades, so I should focus on disciplined position sizing, diversification, and whether each decision improves long-run returns—not on trading for its own sake."]}
